notes_for_editor: Thin record: two sources, and the Forest Lookouts Magnolia page gives only a title block (county spelled 'Mongomery', a typo on the page, so the county is taken from the FFLA index). No build, staffing, fire or site detail found. Two WebSearch calls found no Magnolia-specific history. Leads not read: Edward Cavallerano's Fire in the Piney Woods, and the Texas A&M Forest Service history collection (tfsweb returned HTTP 403). The brief's status and agency agree with the sources, so no corrections are proposed. The story is short because the sources say no more.
